# Twin Flame Bond (twinflame.bond)

Free twin flame and angel number tools built on real numerology and zodiac engines.
All tools run client-side; no data is collected. Content is offered for reflection
and entertainment; numerology/astrology are symbolic traditions.

## Tools
- /tools/twin-flame-calculator.html — Twin Flame Calculator: life paths, master numbers, bond number, zodiac chemistry, weighted score
- /tools/angel-number-lookup.html — Angel Number Decoder: 40+ sequences with meaning, twin-flame layer, action step
- /tools/twin-flame-test.html — 20-question stage test: recognition, testing, crisis, runner-chaser, surrender, union
- /zodiac-compatibility.html — Interactive 144-pairing zodiac compatibility matrix

## Guides
- /stages.html — The 8 stages of a twin flame journey
- /signs.html — 21 real twin flame signs (+ counterfeits)
- /separation.html — Twin flame separation and reunion
